title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
content: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

title: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins
content: Quantum computers can’t break Bitcoin network’s security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
content: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
content: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic and rivals seek AI agent rules to prevent commerce chaos
content: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other technology giants are backing standards designed to enable agents to work together without putting any one company in control.

title: Will Bitcoin’s big rebound hold? More tampered Ledgers found: Hodler’s Digest
content: Bitcoin rebounds sharply from its new cycle low, but is $55,111 really the bottom? Ledger investigates new reports of tampered devices in Berlin and the UAE.

title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
content: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
content: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
content: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in 'Impossible' Game
content: Google’s Willow quantum processor beat the classical ceiling in a four-qubit coordination game, revealing a promising hardware test rather than commercial quantum computing.

title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
content: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
content: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
content: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
content: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

title: Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom Tracy Shuchart says Bitcoin's biggest long-term argument is its monetary scarcity, but investors need to separate the long-term thesis from how it's trading today. title: Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5%
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5% The bitcoin price slipped to near $58,300 on Friday afternoon, briefly dipping under its summer low, as a chip-led selloff sent the Nasdaq down about 5% and dragged crypto stocks and miners sharply lower. This post Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme
content: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme The SEC obtained an asset freeze against Backward Hat Capital and its founders, alleging a $560 million Ponzi scheme sold as AI-driven FX trading funded through crypto. Prosecutors and the CFTC filed parallel cases. This post SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal
content: Bitcoin Magazine Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal Blockstream researchers published a 131-page security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme for Bitcoin, and are asking the community to review it for flaws. This post Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
